first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only running person in this clip, with short dark hair, a dark short-sleeved top, and white shorts. The face, upper body, and shorts are seen from a low frontal angle; the feet may be cropped by the frame.

entities.name: passageway surface
entities.identification: The central passage surface along which Person A travels, paved with light gray panels featuring fine grooves, seams, and dot-like holes, and continuously curving into the depth of the scene.

entities.name: bulkhead
entities.identification: The light gray-white enclosing wall surfaces on both sides of the passageway, featuring panel seams, dark rectangular openings, and built-in facilities.

entities.name: curved structure
entities.identification: The set of large, light-colored arc-shaped components on the image-left and image-right sides of the upper part of the frame, with clearly defined multilayered contours along their inner and outer edges.

entities.name: light strip
entities.identification: The continuous blue-white luminous strips arranged along the outer edges of the curved structures and the adjacent bulkheads; the set does not include the small buttons on the control panels.

entities.name: seat
entities.identification: The set of dark seats on both sides of the passageway, including visible backrests, headrests, and parts of the seat surfaces; the headrests are not a second person.

entities.name: control panel
entities.identification: The set of dark rectangular panels on the bulkheads, beside the desktops, and along the edges of the recesses, with visible groups of bright-colored buttons, indicator areas, or display surfaces.

entities.name: wall niche
entities.identification: The set of bright recessed spaces in the side walls, with white interior walls, rectangular lights, and partial desktops; they need not be inferred to be hatch doors that are opening or closing.

entities.name: bulkhead recess
entities.identification: The set of vertically elongated, rounded recesses on both sides behind Person A in this clip; inside the dark outer edges are elongated light blue-gray inner surfaces and partial horizontal light-colored segments, with small control panels near the edges.
